facts.fact: El Watan reports President Tebboune inaugurated the Centre national algerien des services numeriques, built on two national data centres to host national data in Algeria, including the National Public Services Portal and the National Database.
facts.system: Centre national algerien des services numeriques

facts.fact: El Watan reports a second data centre in Blida is planned to support rollout of the National Database for Public Service, the interoperability platform and the national cloud.

systems.system: Centre national algerien des services numeriques
systems.tiers: two data centres, Mohammadia and planned Blida
